Hoe lang bewaren we gegevens?: How long do we keep data?

Old enquiries that are no longer needed are deleted when we clear out enquiry records. If you engage our services, separate agreements apply to the client file, along with any statutory retention requirements.
Je kunt vragen om inzage, correctie of v: You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data, or restriction of its processing. Where applicable, you can object or request your data in a portable format. You can also lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).
Deze website plaatst geen advertentiecoo: This website does not set advertising or analytics cookies. Technical features of the hosting service may be necessary for security and for the website to function.
